description:
This is a perfect versino of Ben & Jerry's icconic Phish Food ice cream. Yes you need a few bits to get this bang on but is is so worth it!

80g Sugar
2.5g Vanilla extract
30g of high quality Cocoa Powder ( I missed this in the video titles, sorry!)
30g Non-fat powdered milk

Chocolate "Fish":
100g 80% Chocolate
1 Tbsp Water

Marshmallow Creme:
2 large egg whites
1/2 cup (100g) granulated sugar
1/4 teaspoon cream of tartar
1/2 teaspoon pure vanilla extract (optional)

Caramel Sauce:
Shop bought or make your own 👍 we used Jude's Salted Caramel and it is amazing.


This recipe is easy to make and costs much less to make if you have the ingredients or buy enough to make 3 tubs or more. You can make sure you've got plenty of marshmallow and caramel sauce in there too. 


If you enjoyed this video, please consider liking and subscribing, plus pop over to our Instagram and Facebook pages linked below and say hello :)

comments.text:
My great nephew's (age 15) favorite ice cream flavor is B&J's Phish Food. Quite often when we FaceTime (we live 1500 miles apart) he eats Phish Food while we are visiting. I had watched this video a couple of times and thought I could make homemade Phish Food. You may know how teenagers can be, well he scoffed at the idea that I could make Phish Food at home. I accepted the challenge 😁

I found a silicone fish mold on Amazon that was pretty much the same size as used in Phish Food. I used a 70% cacao chocolate bar for the fish. I used Marshmallow Fluff cut with a small amount of Simple Syrup so it wouldn't harden like a rock when frozen. I used Ghirardelli's caramel sauce, and the chocolate ice cream recipe Nick made for the Ice Cream Calculator video. 

Well, the young lad was pretty impressed when I showed him a bowl of the finished product. Seems he now knows his old Great Uncle didn't just fall off the turnip truck.

And, darn if this isn't some delicious ice cream!
